name: Personal Data Protection Act 2010 (Act 709)
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Department of Personal Data Protection (pdp.gov.my) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Department of Personal Data Protection (pdp.gov.my).
